title: Botched install caused installer to stop because it thinks it is installed.
author: mrmikedh
summary: A damaged uninstall left machine installer state that blocks reinstall with 0x81f40001; canonical installer-state reports already track this recovery path.

comment.body: Thanks for clarifying that this is recovery from a damaged uninstall. The same installer-state failure is already tracked in Issue 34299: PowerToys is unavailable, but the installer reports `0x81f40001` and detects an all-users installation. Please continue the recovery discussion there and add the relevant installer log from this machine so the remaining Windows Installer state can be compared in one place. Closing this report as a duplicate of Issue 34299.
